test_agg_relabel: test the pandas DataFrame.agg relabeling feature with a single column and aggregation function
test_agg_relabel_multi_columns_multi_met: test the pandas DataFrame.agg relabeling across multiple columns with different aggregation methods
test_agg_namedtuple: test the pd.NamedAgg API for relabeling DataFrame aggregation results with named tuples
